summary: MENU-ORDER AI is a Boston-based consumer app (officially launched October 28, 2025) that scans restaurant and delivery menus to recommend GLP-1-friendly, high-protein, low-carb, and WeightWatchers-points-compatible items to diners, responding to declining restaurant traffic tied to GLP-1 medication adoption; it also offers a restaurant QR-code program linking directly to tailored menu recommendations with 'no changes to menu, POS, or staff required.'
MENU-ORDER AI surpassed 110,000 downloads and became the #1 app for GLP-1 meal searches on the U.S. Apple App Store, according to a company press release.
